## Agentic SDLC

This repo runs the multi-agent SDLC from Agentic SDLC. Config: `sdlc.config.yaml`.

**Project:** agentic-sdlc-demo (new code)
**Stack:** python, fastapi

### Commands agents must use
- install: `uv sync`
- test: `uv run pytest`
- lint: `uv run ruff check .`
- run: `uv run --with uvicorn uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000`
- secrets: `gitleaks detect --no-banner --redact`

### Standards agents follow
Read the ones listed for you before you start (`sdlc next` lists them per agent; `sdlc standards` shows all).
- Coding standards: `docs/standards/coding.md` (coder, code reviewer, pr reviewer, pr responder +1)
- Testing standards: `docs/standards/testing.md` (test writer, coder, code reviewer, test planner +3)
- Security standards: `docs/standards/security.md` (security reviewer, coder, code reviewer, pr reviewer +2)
- API guidelines: `docs/standards/api.md` (data api designer, coder, code reviewer, doc writer)
- Git, commits and pull requests: `docs/standards/git.md` (coder, pr responder)
- Code review checklist: `docs/standards/code-review.md` (code reviewer, pr reviewer)
- Documentation standards: `docs/standards/documentation.md` (doc writer, architect, ops designer)
- UI and accessibility standards: `docs/standards/ui.md` (ux designer, coder, ui tester)

### Workflow rules
- Every change belongs to a work item (`REQ-xxx`). Put the ID in branch names (`sdlc/REQ-xxx-Tn`), commit messages and PR titles.
- Specs live in `specs/`, ADRs in `docs/adr/`, task plans in `.sdlc/plans/`, reviews in `.sdlc/reviews/`.
- Agents talk through files, not chat. Read the spec and ADR before working; write results back to files.
- The agent that writes code never reviews it.
- Run the test, lint and typecheck commands above before saying a task is done.
- Read and search files with the Read, Glob and Grep tools, not `cat`/`ls`/`grep` in the shell. Use the shell only for
  the commands above, `git`, `sdlc` and the package manager, one command per call (no `;` or `&&` chains).
- Never skip or weaken a quality gate (tests, lint, coverage, secret scan) to make it pass.
- Humans approve every gate. Use the `sdlc` CLI to record progress; never edit `.sdlc/state/` by hand.
